"When an animal needs rescuing, Turtleman is just a call away. Join Ernie Brown Jr., Neal James and Team Turtle as they take on a series of wildlife rescue missions. Whether it’s a snake, raccoon, mink or another unexpected visitor, every encounter brings a new challenge.
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 3, Episodes 14, 12, 2, 13, 20, 15 and 7 on Discovery Channel India."
